runtimePolicy.composition: Pre-authored transparent layers selected deterministically and cached.
runtimePolicy.missingRequiredAssetBehavior: Use an honest development fallback and log the missing stable piece ID. Release certification fails until required source art is present.
runtimePolicy.signaturePolicy: Signature recruits prefer bespoke portrait/standee overrides. A deterministic modular preview is permitted only until bespoke art is produced.
runtimePolicy.protectedActorPolicy: Kael and the Seven Founders never use the normal recruit compositor.
